newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Sept core inflation rises 0.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Sept core inflation rises 0.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish core inflation rose 0.1 percent year-on-year in September after falling 0.1 percent in August, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Friday.
The mean of six economists' forecasts for September core inflation was a 0.1 percent rise in a +/-0 - +0.1 percent range.
The Bank of Finland's target for the year-on-year change in the underlying rate of inflation -- the central bank's chief gauge for monetary policy -- is a rise of no more than around two percent.
